title: CertiSpec: distribution-free certification of predictive values for spectroscopic diagnosis
description: Open-source Python software that certifies positive and negative predictive values of spectroscopic classifiers at any target prevalence from case-control calibration data, using simultaneous order-statistic confidence bands with exactly computed coverage, with abstention and an attribution control.
